Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers should review animal travel requirements before arrival so your journey with Aurelia Skyways proceeds smoothly and safely.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk supports travelers with carrier checks, document review, and guidance on calm handling for pets. Staff will inspect enclosures for secure latches, clean bedding, and enough room for the animal to rest without strain. <<FACT F027>> Please keep your pet close, use a leash or carrier as directed, and follow the instructions given by the desk and the boarding staff.

Please bring all required travel records in clear form and keep the animal well hydrated before check in, unless a veterinarian has advised otherwise. <<FACT F008>> If your pet shows signs of stress, speak at once with the senior coordinator so suitable support can be arranged without delay. Do not sedate an animal unless a qualified veterinarian has provided clear advice for travel.

For safe processing, remain near your pet, handle it gently, and allow staff to complete each inspection step in full. The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is ready to help travelers prepare with care and confidence.
